project: Auto Evolution Real Run Observe Batch
description: Run three fresh normal real Auto Evolution workflows from the latest integrated authority, observe Sidecar Report sufficiency, and record a natural P2 cross-round transition only if it actually occurs.

userStories.title: Preflight the real-run evidence boundary
userStories.description: As the product owner, I want the real-run entry point, Sidecar Report path, and P2 handoff confirmed before execution so that the batch observes the existing product rather than a deterministic test path. See PRD §4.
acceptanceCriteria: PRD A first matrix is accepted as CONTRACT_CONFORMANCE_PROMISING with Human qualifier PROMISING_WITH_CAVEATS, and Gate B delta review permits ordinary RUN / OBSERVE to continue
Execution branch is based on the latest clean authoritative tip
Active authority contains participant/model hard-timeout policy v1 with default hard boundary 1800000ms, or an explicit newer Human-approved successor; stale 240000ms authority blocks execution
Three fresh run slots are defined without pre-selecting desired outcomes
Actual real workflow entry point is identified and is not deterministic P2 test scaffolding
Sidecar Run Report generation remains sidecar-only
P2 handoff occurs only on actual READY_FOR_CONFIG_EXECUTION
No source modification is required merely to start observation
Current hard-timeout, retry, retransmission, Structured Output Contract, and permission policies remain unchanged
Requested route/binding provenance is defined; concrete model identity is recorded only if transport directly exposes it
Tests pass
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: See PRD §2–§4. Gate clear on tip 7bd1a24 (PD-099 1800000ms). Preflight evidence: .tmp/evolution/real-run-observe-batch-20260829/preflight.json; host ready; three slots DEFINED with no desired outcomes; NO_PRODUCT_SOURCE_CHANGE for observation start.

userStories.title: Execute fresh real run 1
userStories.description: As the product owner, I want one fresh normal real run recorded exactly as it unfolds so that operational evidence is not biased toward a desired route. See PRD §5.
acceptanceCriteria: Exactly one fresh attributable real run is executed
Problem selection does not guarantee or steer READY_FOR_CONFIG_EXECUTION
Role sequence, structured outcome, Reviewer decision, final route, and Sidecar report are recorded
Requested execution route/binding is recorded; resolved concrete model identity is recorded only if directly exposed by transport evidence
Slice #2 retransmission is observed only if its existing Solution ENVELOPE_FAILURE trigger legitimately occurs
If READY_FOR_CONFIG_EXECUTION naturally occurs, only the already-authorized P2 path may continue
If READY_FOR_CONFIG_EXECUTION does not occur, the actual outcome closes the run without replacement
No unauthorized Runtime, Framework, Contract, or product-source change is made
Tests pass
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: See PRD §5. Slot 1 executed: outcome NO_CROSS_ROUND_TRANSITION_OBSERVED / ROUND_1_TERMINAL_NOT_READY; workflow PARTICIPANT_FAILURE at IMPROVEMENT_HYPOTHESIS (parse) route DEFER; sidecar report written; no READY steering; evidence under .tmp/evolution/real-run-observe-batch-20260829/slots/slot-01/.

userStories.title: Execute fresh real run 2
userStories.description: As the product owner, I want a second independent fresh normal real run so that observation is not selected to compensate for run 1. See PRD §6.
acceptanceCriteria: Exactly one additional fresh attributable real run is executed
Problem selection is independent of US-002 desired outcome
Actual workflow outcome is preserved without route steering
Requested execution route/binding is recorded; resolved concrete model identity is recorded only if directly exposed by transport evidence
Sidecar report and structured/provenance evidence are attributable
Any P2 transition is natural and uses existing authority only
No forced retry or forced Round 2 occurs
Tests pass
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: See PRD §6. Evidence-only / NO_SOURCE_CHANGE is valid.

userStories.title: Execute fresh real run 3
userStories.description: As the product owner, I want a third independent fresh normal real run so that the batch reaches the planned small sample without manufacturing success. See PRD §7.
acceptanceCriteria: Exactly one additional fresh attributable real run is executed
Total valid fresh batch size is three
Actual workflow outcome is preserved regardless of actionability
Requested execution route/binding is recorded; resolved concrete model identity is recorded only if directly exposed by transport evidence
Sidecar report is attributable
Any P2 transition is natural and no Round 2 is forced
No unauthorized source/framework change occurs
Tests pass
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: See PRD §7. Do not replace a valid non-actionable run merely to obtain READY.

userStories.title: Synthesize real-run and Sidecar Report evidence
userStories.description: As the product owner, I want the three-run batch summarized into P2 observation and report-sufficiency conclusions so that the next decision is based on real workflow evidence. See PRD §8.
acceptanceCriteria: All three run outcomes are summarized without subjective Participant quality scoring
P2 conclusion is exactly CROSS_ROUND_TRANSITION_OBSERVED, NO_CROSS_ROUND_TRANSITION_OBSERVED, or OBSERVATION_INSUFFICIENT
Absence of a natural cross-round transition is not treated as an implementation defect
Sidecar report sufficiency is assessed per run for identity, roles, structured outcomes, Reviewer decision, execution, and terminal reason
If reports are sufficient, result records NO_REPORT_CHANGE
Any report correction is minimal, objective, sidecar-only, and does not introduce Report Analysis
Current-product-stage is updated only if real evidence changes an explicit status
Tests pass
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: See PRD §8. Stop after synthesis and return to Human delta review.
